bagPolicy.summary: Under UW’s posted policy, bags up to 8.5" x 11" and clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Backpacks and larger bags are not.
allowed: Clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: This is the UW Kohl Center carry-in policy written for athletics events; UW applied the same bag limits at past Kohl Center concerts. There is no on-site storage for prohibited items.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Kohl Center. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at events.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Official venue guidance describes assistive-listening support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Official venue guidance states that guests may not re-enter after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For Badgers basketball, the Kohl Center will call window is in the main ticket lobby inside Gate B and opens one hour before tip-off. Bring a photo ID to pick up tickets. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: Official venue guidance says doors or gates open 5 hours before the event time described on the linked page; special-event timing may vary.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
